name: sh
note: The Unix shell as a scripting language for gluing processes
typeSystem: Untyped: shell parameters hold strings, while commands also produce integer exit statuses and the language has special arithmetic and test contexts.
runtime: Parsed and executed by a shell, which handles built-ins and control flow and launches external programs

runtimes.name: POSIX shell (for example dash or bash in POSIX mode)
runtimes.role: Parses shell programs, executes built-ins and control flow, and launches external commands.

compilers.name: bash / dash / zsh
compilers.role: Shell interpreters that parse and execute shell scripts.

concurrencyExample.caption: 4 workers computing i*i in parallel via background jobs
concurrencyExample.source:
#!/bin/sh
for i in 0 1 2 3; do
  echo $((i * i)) &
done
wait
